cover: What a prototype skips before it can hold health data

slides.title: The workflow was already right
slides.body: A senior-care operator ran its concierge team on a low-code prototype. The screens matched how the team really worked.

slides.title: But it had no users
slides.body: The “submitted by” field was a dropdown of six hard-coded names. Now there are invite-only accounts with two-factor and passkeys.

slides.title: Everyone could see everything
slides.body: Each facility's records are now separated underneath every query. A facility user sees only their own facilities.

slides.title: Nothing recorded who changed what
slides.body: An append-only audit log now keeps a timeline on every record and for every user.

slides.title: We audited it before launch
slides.body: Two reviews against 33 facilities of test data found 48 issues. Eight were fixed the same night.
